missing_policy: preserve exact null mask; never cross missing segments
p2_policy: unchanged original masks and warnings in all conditions
time_policy: all S0/S1/S2 use decoded_pts_s minus first decoded PTS as timestamp_s; preserve NPZ nominal timestamp in npz_timestamp_s and keep nominal fps metadata unchanged
scale_policy: mean median torso side lengths + mean median thigh lengths + mean median calf lengths; prefer >=5 P2-visible warning-free observations per edge, otherwise finite raw observations; fallback 1 model unit only if unavailable

S1.vector_adaptive_cutoff: Euclidean filtered velocity / clip body scale; one alpha per 3D joint

S2.speed_blend: smooth fraction = 1/(1+(max adjacent raw normalized speed/4)^2)
S2.constraint_policy: only original P2-visible edges with both endpoint warnings false; proximal-to-distal; cap each child displacement; translate available same-side heel/toe by ankle correction
S2.boundary_policy: if <5 same-segment samples, keep original coordinate

metrics.impact_annotation: absent: all fast-motion windows are raw wrist speed proxies, not impact truth
